findings: [P1] Preserve invalid model-server responses in the immutable snapshot. models.infer parses the server body and raises ModelResponseError when choices/message/content is absent; service.execute_run then records response_error with model_output=null, so the body and information actually returned by the server are lost. Malformed JSON is also caught by the generic model_error path rather than the distinct response_error path. This violates the SPEC scope plus REQ-005 and REQ-006, which require an empty or invalid response to be preserved as a failure with stage-specific state.

[P2] Reconcile AC-004 evidence after fixing the response path. test_response_and_verification_failures_have_distinct_states proves preservation of an empty string and a valid raw response when verification raises, but it does not drive malformed JSON or an invalid chat-completion shape through models.infer. Add a lossless invalid-response test at the client/service boundary and update completion.json so AC-004 does not claim full response-failure coverage before that case passes.
evidence: Fresh validation on 2026-10-14: all 9 inference_api unit tests passed and git diff --check exited 0.

VAL-004 is now materially better grounded than the earlier deferred description: the test inspects the exact /v1/chat/completions top-level keys and message contents, verifies the serialized saved evidence bundle is the response-agent input, and rejects a browser-supplied sql field before opening a source connection.

The outbound model payload contains model, messages, temperature, max_tokens and stream. Backend credentials and database connection objects are absent. The evidence JSON intentionally includes the backend-owned fixed parameterized query template for provenance; it is not browser-selected SQL.

The only source SQL is the QUERIES backend allowlist. Source connections are constrained to 127.0.0.1:5544 and the expected database names, use readonly transactions, set a 5-second statement timeout and execute positional year parameters.

The runtime code contains no gold set. The verifier explicitly records numerical_truth=not_checked and causality=not_checked; integrated evidence warns that temporal coincidence supports association only.

A read-only scan of preserved source CSVs independently reproduced the completion counts for 2020: 13 venda rows and 35136 registro_operacao rows. It also yielded 460993.44 for the fixed sales formula and 3506484 for the fixed industrial quantity formula.

BancoModeloUse/reports/local_database_validation.json is an older 2026-10-11 import-validation artifact reporting bidirectional source/database verification and total typed rows. The completion receipt's direct existing-load database readback was not freshly repeated during this review.

Model provenance remains deliberately incomplete: base_revision, adapter_run and adapter_hash are null, no remote vLLM response was validated, and the documents state that the local catalog is not proof of served weights. Therefore this implementation is not evidence of reproducible scientific inference.

The isolated invalid-response probe returned {status: response_error, model_output: null, evidence_preserved: true}, confirming the blocking persistence defect without contacting a remote model or database.
